description: This file contains a PHP class 'Marketing' within the namespace 'Opencart.Admin.Model.Extension.Opencart.Report'. The class extends a system engine Model and provides methods to retrieve marketing report data, including detailed marketing metrics and total marketing counts, with support for filtering by date ranges and order status.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: A model class for retrieving marketing-related reports, extending the system's core Model class.

methods.name: getMarketing
methods.description: Retrieves a list of marketing campaigns with statistics such as clicks and orders, supporting filters for order status and date range, with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalMarketing
methods.description: Returns the total count of marketing campaigns for reporting purposes.
